items.name: Julia Tuttle Causeway (I-195) from the real OSM centerlines: 2 x 3 lanes, bridges over water, fill on the islands, tied to the mainland and beach grids, corridor cleared
Headless GPS: mainland 36th St -> Miami Beach 41st St 29.3 -> 5.4 km (N Miami Ave -> Collins 29.2 -> 7.2 km)
Barriers, walls, piers: own grey concrete material (was near-white: vertex colours are linear, 0.5-0.86 read as sRGB 0.73-0.94), grime gradient and per-section tone
Retaining walls on embankments: coping with drip lip, precast panel joints, batter, footing
No barrier end caps / cushions where another deck's barrier continues (no overlapping ends)
Lane and edge lines follow the visible deck and stay clear of the barrier toe
HUD street name: multi-ref values read 'US-1 / SR 970'
Ground streets under the ramps (junction pads, crosswalks, signals, curb ramps, dirt ground)
79th St / JFK and Broad Causeways (beyond the OSM pull; the synthetic north bay has a different shape)
Julia Tuttle: both carriageways carry their own barriers (median side included); the "blue deck" was the shaded inner face of the left barrier
I-95 north -> I-395 east ramp re-linked just outside the rectangle (merge, tools/osm/roads.py _seam_ramps): no more West Line Avenue detour
Mid/far LOD decks and barriers inset inside the full-detail geometry (no LOD slab in front of the jersey barrier)
Shaded concrete faces read dark blue-grey (sky-only fill); needs a lighting / AO look, not more albedo
